name: Grisaille
description: The paint-in-greys underpainting: near-zero chroma across the full lightness range.
check_or_gap: FILLS achromatic — no thread-based neutral set exists.

name: Chiaroscuro
description: Any hue at very low brightness, plus a narrow high-key band. The gap between them is the style.
check_or_gap: FILLS all-hue dark — Deep sea is cool, Rainforest is green.

name: Vermilion and madder
description: The red arc alone, scarlet through crimson to rose, held at chroma so it never drifts to brick.
check_or_gap: FILLS red — Autumn leaves starts at hue 10 and is orange in practice.

name: Fresco lime plaster
description: What survives being painted into wet lime: earth hues capped at middling chroma, held bright.
check_or_gap: Check against Sepia — broader and much darker.

name: Verdigris and bronze
description: Copper oxides against warm unweathered metal.
check_or_gap: Fills the seam between Rainforest and Deep sea.

name: Sumi ink wash
description: A warm-black dilution ladder — the warm counterpart to Grisaille.
check_or_gap: Ladder. Judge at low colour limits too (D204).

name: Cave ochre and charcoal
description: Red ochre, yellow ochre, charcoal, chalk white. The oldest palette there is.
check_or_gap: Four or five entries — tests the low end of the count floor.

name: Egg tempera and gold ground
description: Vermilion, lapis, ochre, verdigris, gold, ivory — the icon painter’s shelf.
check_or_gap: Opens medieval and devotional territory.

name: Expressionist woodcut
description: Black, raw paper white, one or two unmixed colours cut into the block.
check_or_gap: Deliberate counterweight to Ukiyo-e’s refinement.

name: Botanical plate
description: Hand-coloured engraving on cream: soft leaf greens, madder pinks, ochre, sepia line.
check_or_gap: Check against Spring meadow.

name: Terrazzo
description: A pale ground band carrying most of the area, plus all-hue mid-chroma chips.
check_or_gap: A ground-plus-confetti shape the gallery has never had.

name: Brutalist concrete
description: Board-marked concrete: near-neutral mids with a cool cast, plus rust and moss staining.
check_or_gap: INVESTIGATE — may be redundant against Moorland.

name: Transit map lines
description: One entry per hue sextant at maximum mutual separation — colours built never to be confused.
check_or_gap: FILLS distinguishability. At most one of this and Topographic map per batch.

name: Anodised aluminium
description: The dyed-metal set: violet-blue, acid green, gold, red, and raw silver.
check_or_gap: FILLS violet — the largest unclaimed region.

name: Vitreous enamel signage
description: Deep blue, white, red, black — the street-sign and shopfront set.
check_or_gap: Check against De Stijl primaries.

name: International typographic
description: Red, black, white, one grey. The Swiss poster grid.
check_or_gap: Ship at most one of this and Constructivist.

name: Constructivist
description: Red, black, cream, ochre — the warmer, dirtier cousin, on stock that was never white.
check_or_gap: Ship at most one of this and International typographic.

name: Ceramic glaze
description: Celadon, tenmoku, oxblood, ash, iron. Kiln colours: muted and deep.
check_or_gap: Sits between Moorland and Deep sea.

name: Shipping container
description: Everything faded by a year at sea: mid chroma across all hues, nothing bright, nothing black.
check_or_gap: Check against Moorland — brighter and hue-unrestricted.

name: High-visibility safety
description: Fluoro yellow-green and orange against black and retroreflective silver.
check_or_gap: FILLS acid. Ship at most one of this and Hazard and warning.

name: Hazard and warning
description: The three signage pairs: yellow on black, white on red, white on blue.
check_or_gap: Overlaps High-visibility safety at yellow.

name: Machinery and plant
description: Plant green-grey, dust yellow, oxide primer red, black. The colours of things built to be repainted.
check_or_gap: Muted-but-warm; between Moorland and Sepia without being either.

name: Maritime signal flags
description: Red, yellow, blue, black, white. Five colours fixed by a real system for legibility at distance.
check_or_gap: The cleanest curated case in the pool — tiny and provenanced.

name: Railway livery
description: Bottle green, maroon, cream, black, with fine lining one stitch wide.
check_or_gap: Deep saturated darks; nothing shipped occupies this corner.

name: Cockpit instrument
description: Dark panel grey-green, amber, white, warning red. Designed to be read in the dark.
check_or_gap: Structurally like Neon noir, tonally nothing like it.

name: Circuit board
description: Solder-mask green, gold pad, black component, tinned silver, red and blue jumper wire.
check_or_gap: A dark, yellow-leaning green unlike Rainforest.

name: Handheld green LCD
description: Four greens and no more. The clearest ladder in the pool.
check_or_gap: Ladder. Judge at low colour limits too (D204).

name: Green phosphor
description: Black to a single green, by brightness alone.
check_or_gap: Pairs with Amber phosphor — ship both or neither.

name: Amber phosphor
description: The same shape one hue over.
check_or_gap: Pairs with Green phosphor.

name: Four-colour adapter
description: Black, cyan, magenta, white; the alternate mode swaps in red, green and dark yellow. The restriction is the style.
check_or_gap: Not Retro 16 — the point is what is missing.

name: Composite artefact colour
description: The purple, green, blue and orange fringes that appeared where no colour was ever sent.
check_or_gap: Nothing in the gallery resembles it.

name: Home micro brights
description: Eight hues at two brightness levels — the dim/bright pairing is the whole character.
check_or_gap: INVESTIGATE — may collapse into 1-bit RGB without the pairing.

name: Home console
description: The washed, low-contrast console palette with no true saturation at the extremes.
check_or_gap: INVESTIGATE — check against pool A 8-bit arcade.

name: Teal and orange
description: A warm skin arc against a cool shadow arc, greens and magentas left out.
check_or_gap: FILLS the warm/cool pole shape — Neon noir is magenta/cyan.

name: Cross-processed
description: Highlights pushed yellow-green, shadows pushed cyan-blue.
check_or_gap: A hue split by brightness, which no shipped profile does.

name: Instant film
description: Milky and warm: low chroma at mid-to-high brightness with the hue range skewed off neutral.
check_or_gap: Check against Pastels — lighter and hue-free.

name: Sun-bleached print
description: Cyan dye fades first, so an old print drifts magenta-yellow.
check_or_gap: Check against Sepia — this keeps pink.

name: Bleach bypass
description: Chroma stripped almost out, blacks kept full.
check_or_gap: INVESTIGATE — likely redundant against Grisaille and Moorland.

name: Screen-plate colour
description: The earliest colour photography: soft orange-red, green and blue-violet grains over a warm haze.
check_or_gap: Named by process — the maker’s mark is now in the guard.

name: Natural dye garden
description: Weld yellow, madder red, woad blue, walnut brown, onion gold. What a dye plot actually yields.
check_or_gap: Provenanced and genuinely small. Strong candidate.

name: Indigo dip
description: Each dip darkens the last.
check_or_gap: INVESTIGATE — check against pool A Sashiko indigo, same shape.

name: Tartan sett
description: Bottle green, navy, deep red, black, with white and yellow overchecks one thread wide.
check_or_gap: Check against Fair Isle — darker, dyed rather than undyed.

name: Undyed fleece
description: White, oatmeal, moorit brown, grey, black — the colours sheep come in.
check_or_gap: INVESTIGATE — Fair Isle already opens on undyed wool (3866, 3045).

name: Kente
description: Gold, maroon, forest green, black, blue, in strip-woven cloth where each colour carries meaning.
check_or_gap: Cultural naming — owner’s explicit call.

name: Suzani
description: Madder, indigo, saffron, cream: Central Asian embroidery in silk on a plain ground.
check_or_gap: Check against pool A Kilim — same dye tradition.

name: Sari and zari
description: Saturated silk grounds shot through with metallic gold thread.
check_or_gap: Check against Gemstones — chroma with no metal.

name: Heraldic tinctures
description: Gules, azure, vert, sable, or, argent, purpure — seven colours fixed for eight centuries.
check_or_gap: FILLS violet via a defined system, so membership is not a taste call.

name: Laboratory stain
description: Haematoxylin blue-purple against eosin pink, on white.
check_or_gap: FILLS the violet-to-pink corner, which nothing shipped enters.

name: Geological map
description: The stratigraphic period colours: pale yet oddly saturated, standardised internationally.
check_or_gap: A light-and-chromatic register that exists nowhere else.

name: Topographic map
description: Buff contours, blue water, woodland green, road orange, grey grid on white.
check_or_gap: Never name a national mapping agency. At most one of this and Transit map lines per batch.

name: Nautical chart
description: Buff land, depth-banded blues, magenta symbols, black soundings.
check_or_gap: Depth bands are ladder-shaped; admissible since D204.

name: Foundry heat
description: Black through cherry red, orange and yellow to white. The blackbody curve.
check_or_gap: The most legible ramp in the pool.

name: Stellar temperature
description: Red through white to blue — a ladder that crosses hue rather than staying on one.
check_or_gap: Ladder. Judge at low colour limits too (D204).

name: Cyanotype
description: Paper white to Prussian blue, with nothing between but dilution.
check_or_gap: Ladder. Judge at low colour limits too (D204).

name: Institution green
description: The pale green-grey of hospitals, schools and swimming baths: narrow, cool, low chroma, held bright.
check_or_gap: FILLS light-and-muted-with-hue — Pastels is hue-free.

name: Allotment and shed
description: Creosote brown, sage paint, terracotta pot, galvanised grey.
check_or_gap: Check against Moorland — warmer and lighter throughout.

name: Fairground and carousel
description: Red, gold, cream, deep green, mirror silver — gilded and lined.
check_or_gap: Check against pool A Rave flyer — ornate, not flat.

name: Enamelware kitchen
description: Cream body, deep green or navy trim, one red handle.
check_or_gap: Overlaps Vitreous enamel signage in material, not in use.

name: Sports pitch and playground
description: Primary plastics on pitch green and asphalt grey, white line-marking through it.
check_or_gap: Bright primaries on a dull ground — a contrast structure nothing shipped has.

name: Harbour town
description: Painted terraces: chalky pinks, blues and ochres against white, weathered by salt air.
check_or_gap: INVESTIGATE — close to pool A Summer coast.
